== head: removes-the-test-script
toolchain_refused: the worktree removed test of package.json; a step the base commit had is never lost at the head, so nothing was run. Land the change in a commit of its own, or name the commands in .coai/toolchain.yaml

== head: adds-a-cargo-toml
toolchain_refused: 'packages/a/Cargo.toml' is a rust manifest at the head commit; rust is a known stack with no adapter yet, so a repository that holds one is not checked by guessing; name the commands in .coai/toolchain.yaml

== head: renames-a-folder
